defs.en: belonging to or relating to the person or people that you are talking or writing to
belonging to or relating to people in general

ex.en: Are you taller than your brother?
ex.cn: 你比你的弟弟高吗？

ex.en: I left your newspaper on your desk.
ex.cn: 我把你的报纸放到你的桌子上了。

ex.en: You should always wash your hands after touching raw meat.
ex.cn: 摸过生肉之后应该洗手。

defs.en: belonging or relating to yourself

ex.en: We can eat at my house tonight.
ex.cn: 今晚我们可以在我家吃饭。

defs.en: recently created or invented
not used or owned by anyone before you
different from before

ex.en: They've just opened a new hotel.
ex.cn: 他们刚刚建成了一家新酒店。

ex.en: These ideas are not new.
ex.cn: 这些想法并不新鲜。

ex.en: That afternoon she went out and bought a new dress.
ex.cn: 那天下午她出去买了一条新裙子。

defs.en: a period of twelve months, beginning on the first of January and ending on the thirty-first of December
any period of twelve months
the period of time in the year when schools or universities are open
used for talking about a long time

ex.en: The year was 1840.
ex.cn: 这一年是1840年。

ex.en: We had an election last year.
ex.cn: 去年我们有一次选举。

ex.en: The castle has more than 650,000 visitors a year.
ex.cn: 这座城堡一年的游客量超过65万人次。

defs.en: the word or words that you use to talk to a particular person, or to talk about them
the word or words that you use to talk about a particular place or thing
to give someone or something a name

ex.en: `What's his name?' — `Peter.'
ex.cn: “他叫什么名字？”——“彼得。”

ex.en: What is the name of this street?
ex.cn: 这条街叫什么名字？

ex.en: Can you tell me the name of this plant?
ex.cn: 你能告诉我这种植物的名称是什么吗？

defs.en: used for asking about the way that something happens or is done
used for asking questions about time, or the amount or age of something
used when you are asking someone whether something was good
used for asking if someone is well

ex.en: How do you spell his name?
ex.cn: 你怎么拼写他的名字？

ex.en: `How do you get to work?' `By bus.'
ex.cn: “你怎么上班？”“坐公交。”

ex.en: How does a mobile phone work?
ex.cn: 手机是如何工作的？

defs.en: having lived for many years; not young
used for talking or asking about the age of someone or something
having existed for a long time
used for talking about something that used to be part of your life

ex.en: Mr Kaufmann was a small old man with a beard.
ex.cn: 考夫曼先生是一位留着胡子的老人。

ex.en: He is three months old.
ex.cn: 他三个月大。

ex.en: Her car is less than three years old.
ex.cn: 她的车用了不到三年。

defs.en: the mark that a teacher gives you to show how good your work is
the level of quality of a product
to judge the quality of something

ex.en: The best grade you can get is an A.
ex.cn: 最好的成绩是A。

ex.en: The price of all grades of petrol has gone up.
ex.cn: 各种品级的汽油都涨价了。

ex.en: Teachers grade the students' work from A to F.
ex.cn: 老师对学生的作业按从A到F评分。

defs.en: used for describing someone that you love

defs.cn: （用于书信或电子邮件开头收信人名字之前）亲爱的
defs.en: used at the beginning of a letter or an email before the name of the person you are writing to

ex.en: Mrs Cavendish is a dear friend of mine.
ex.cn: 卡文迪什夫人是我的密友。

ex.en: Dear Peter, How are you?
ex.cn: 亲爱的彼得，你好吗？

ex.en: Dear Sir or Madam...
ex.cn: 敬启者…

defs.en: all the physical parts of a person or an animal
the main part of a person's or an animal's body, but not their arms, head and legs
a dead person or animal

ex.en: Yoga creates a healthy mind in a healthy body.
ex.cn: 瑜伽促进身心健康。

ex.en: Lying flat on your back, twist your body onto one side.
ex.cn: 身体躺平，将躯干向一侧扭。

ex.en: Two days later, her body was found in a wood.
ex.cn: 两天后，她的尸体在树林中被发现。

defs.en: the number of years that you have lived
the state of being old
a period in history
to cause someone to look much older than before

ex.en: Diana left school at the age of 16.
ex.cn: 戴安娜16岁时离校。

ex.en: He refuses to let age slow him down.
ex.cn: 他不愿年纪大了就失去活力。

ex.en: the age of silent films
ex.cn: 无声电影时期

defs.en: the fine threads that grow on your head
the short threads that grow on the bodies of humans and animals

ex.en: I wash my hair every night.
ex.cn: 我每天晚上洗头。

ex.en: There were dog hairs all over the sofa.
ex.cn: 沙发上满是狗毛。

defs.en: a group of students who learn at school together
a time when you learn something at school
a group of things that are the same in some way
a group of people with the same economic and social position in a society

ex.en: He spent six months in a class with younger students.
ex.cn: 他和比自己年纪小的学生在一个班里上了6个月的课。

ex.en: Classes start at 9 o'clock.
ex.cn: 9点开始上课。

ex.en: We do lots of reading in class.
ex.cn: 我们在课堂上做了大量阅读。

defs.en: the top part of your body that has your eyes, mouth and brain in it
your mind
the person who is in charge of a company or an organization
the top, the start or the most important end of something

ex.en: The ball came down and hit him on the head.
ex.cn: 球落下来，打在他的头上。

ex.en: I just said the first thing that came into my head.
ex.cn: 我只说了我脑海里出现的第一件事。

ex.en: I spoke to the head of the department.
ex.cn: 我和部门经理谈过了。

defs.en: one of the long parts of a person's or an animal's body that they use for walking and standing
one of the parts of a pair of trousers that cover your legs
one of the long parts of a table or a chair that it stands on

ex.en: He broke his right leg in a motorcycle accident.
ex.cn: 他在一次摩托车事故中摔断了右腿。

ex.en: Anthony dried his hands on the legs of his jeans.
ex.cn: 安东尼在牛仔裤的裤腿上擦干了双手。

ex.en: a broken chair leg
ex.cn: 断了的椅子腿

defs.en: one of the two parts of your body between your shoulders and your hands
the part of a chair on which you rest your arm when you are sitting down
the part of a piece of clothing that covers your arm
to provide someone with a weapon

ex.en: She stretched her arms out.
ex.cn: 她伸开手臂。

ex.en: Mack held the arms of the chair.
ex.cn: 麦克抓住椅子扶手。

ex.en: The coat was short in the arms.
ex.cn: 这件外套的袖子短了。

defs.en: the part of your body at the end of your arm that you use for holding things
one of the long thin parts on a clock or a watch that move to show the time
to put something into someone's hand

ex.en: I put my hand into my pocket and took out the letter.
ex.cn: 我把手伸进口袋里，拿出了那封信。

ex.en: He handed me a piece of paper.
ex.cn: 他递给我一张纸。

defs.en: the part of your body that is at the end of your leg, and that you stand on

defs.cn: 英尺（长度单位，1英尺=12英寸或30.48厘米）
defs.en: a unit for measuring length. A foot is equal to 30.48 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot. The plural form is <rf>feet</rf> or <rf>foot</rf>
the part of something that is furthest from its top

ex.en: We danced until our feet were sore.
ex.cn: 我们跳舞跳到脚痛。

ex.en: He's suffering from a foot injury.
ex.cn: 他正忍受着脚伤。

ex.en: We were six thousand feet above sea level.
ex.cn: 我们当时在海拔6000英尺的地方。

defs.en: the front part of your head
the front or a vertical side of something
to look in a particular direction
to have to deal with something unpleasant

ex.en: She had a beautiful face.
ex.cn: 她容貌秀丽。

ex.en: the south face of Mount Qomolangma
ex.cn: 珠穆朗玛峰南坡面

defs.en: one of the two parts of your body with which you see

ex.en: I opened my eyes and looked.
ex.cn: 我睁开眼睛看。

ex.en: Mrs Brooke was a tall lady with dark brown eyes.
ex.cn: 布鲁克太太个子高高的，双眼深褐色。

defs.en: the part of your face above your mouth, that you use for smelling and breathing

ex.en: She wiped her nose with a tissue.
ex.cn: 她用纸巾擦了擦鼻子。

defs.en: to make someone or something feel pain
used for saying that you feel pain in a part of your body
to say or do something that makes someone unhappy

ex.en: Yasin hurt himself while he was playing football.
ex.cn: 亚辛在踢足球的时候弄伤了自己。

ex.en: I fell over and hurt my leg yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天我摔倒了，把腿摔伤了。

defs.cn: 坏的；有害的；令人不快的
defs.en: unpleasant or harmful

defs.cn: 低劣的；劣质的；少得可怜的
defs.en: of a very low standard, quality or amount
unable to do something well
painful or not working properly because of illness or injury

ex.en: When the weather was bad, I stayed indoors.
ex.cn: 天气不好时，我待在屋里。

ex.en: When Ross and Judy heard the bad news, they were very upset.
ex.cn: 罗斯和朱迪得知这个坏消息，沮丧万分。

ex.en: Too much coffee is bad for you.
ex.cn: 喝太多咖啡对你不好。

defs.en: to use your teeth to cut into or through something
if a snake or an insect bites, it makes a mark or a hole in your skin with a sharp part of its body
a small piece of food that you cut into with your teeth

defs.cn: （兽、蛇牙咬的）伤口；（昆虫叮咬的）包块
defs.en: a painful mark on your body where an animal, a snake or an insect has bitten you

ex.en: William bit into his sandwich.
ex.cn: 威廉咬了一口三明治。

ex.en: Do these flies bite?
ex.cn: 这些蝇咬人吗？

ex.en: He was bitten by a snake last year but made a full recovery.
ex.cn: 去年他被蛇咬了，不过已经痊愈了。

defs.en: to make it easier for someone to do something
to improve a situation

ex.en: Can somebody help me, please?
ex.cn: 请问有人能帮我吗？

ex.en: You can help by giving them some money.
ex.cn: 你可以给他们一些钱来帮忙。

ex.en: Thanks for your advice. That helps.
ex.cn: 谢谢你的建议，很有帮助。

defs.en: the soft part inside your mouth that moves when you speak or eat

ex.en: I walked over to the mirror and stuck my tongue out.
ex.cn: 我走到镜子前伸出舌头。

ex.en: She had a nasty tongue.
ex.cn: 她满口脏话。

defs.en: the part of your face that you use for eating or speaking
the entrance or opening of a cave or a bottle
the place where a river goes into the sea

ex.en: When you cough, please cover your mouth.
ex.cn: 咳嗽时请捂住嘴。

ex.en: He stopped at the mouth of the tunnel.
ex.cn: 他在隧道口停了下来。

ex.en: ...the town at the mouth of the River Fox.
ex.cn: …位于福克斯河河口的那座城镇。

defs.en: one of the two parts of your body that you hear sounds with

ex.en: He whispered something in her ear.
ex.cn: 他在她耳边嘀咕了几句。

defs.en: the part of each day between the time that people usually wake up and noon

ex.en: Tomorrow morning we will take a walk around the city.
ex.cn: 明早我们在城里走一走。

ex.en: On Sunday morning the telephone woke Bill.
ex.cn: 星期天早晨电话吵醒了比尔。

defs.en: the part of a tree that contains seeds, covered with a substance that you can often eat

ex.cn: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜提供纤维素和多种维生素。

ex.en: ...bananas and other tropical fruits.
ex.cn: …香蕉和其他热带水果。

defs.en: a soft, red fruit that you can eat raw in salads or cook like a vegetable

ex.en: It's similar in size to a tomato.
ex.cn: 大小和西红柿差不多。

ex.en: The tomato hit the wall with a splat.
ex.cn: 西红柿啪的一声打在墙上。

defs.en: a hard, round, white vegetable with brown or red skin. Potatoes grow under the ground.

ex.en: a political hot potato such as abortion.
ex.cn: …像堕胎这样的政治性烫手山芋。

defs.en: the part of each day that begins at lunchtime and ends at about six o'clock

ex.en: He's arriving in the afternoon.
ex.cn: 他今天下午到。

ex.en: He stayed in his room all afternoon.
ex.cn: 他整个下午都待在房间里。

defs.en: a very cold sweet food that is made from frozen cream
a portion of ice cream

ex.en: Serve the pie warm with vanilla ice cream.
ex.cn: 趁热把馅饼端上桌，配上香草冰激凌。

ex.en: Do you want an ice cream?
ex.cn: 你要来一份冰激凌吗？

defs.cn: 可乐饮料，一杯可乐；可乐果树

ex.en: a can of cola.
ex.cn: …一罐可乐。

defs.en: the part of an animal that people cook and eat

ex.en: I don't eat meat or fish.
ex.cn: 我不吃肉，也不吃鱼。

defs.en: long, thin strips of pasta (= a type of food made from eggs, flour and water) used especially in Chinese and Italian cooking

ex.en: Would you prefer rice or noodles?
ex.cn: 你喜欢吃米饭还是面条？

ex.en: There are restaurants, both humble and expensive, that specialize in noodles.
ex.cn: 既有普通的也有昂贵的专营面条的餐馆。

defs.en: to get something by paying money for it

ex.en: He could not afford to buy a house.
ex.cn: 他买不起房子。

ex.en: Lizzie bought herself a bike.
ex.cn: 莉齐给自己买了一辆自行车。

defs.en: white or brown grains from a plant that grows in wet areas

ex.en: The meal consisted of chicken, rice and vegetables.
ex.cn: 这顿饭包括鸡肉、米饭和蔬菜。

defs.en: a bird that lives near water

ex.en: A few ducks were swimming around in the shallow water.
ex.cn: 几只鸭子在浅浅的水中游来游去。

defs.en: a plant that you can cook and eat

ex.en: A good general diet should include plenty of fresh vegetables.
ex.cn: 一份良好的日常饮食应当包括大量的新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: compounds of animal, vegetable or mineral origin.
ex.cn: …来自动物、植物或矿物的化合物。

defs.en: a small animal that has long ears and lives in a hole in the ground

ex.cn: 狗嗅到了兔子的气味。

ex.en: The dog scented a rabbit.
ex.cn: 狗嗅到了兔子的气息。

defs.en: to hit someone or something with your foot
to move your legs up and down quickly
an act of hitting someone or something with your foot
a feeling of pleasure or excitement

ex.cn: 他使劲儿踢了踢门。

ex.en: He kicked the ball away.
ex.cn: 他把球踢开了。

ex.en: Abby was taken away, kicking and screaming.
ex.cn: 阿比被带走时又踢又叫的。

defs.en: a food made mostly from flour and water

ex.en: She bought a loaf of bread at the shop.
ex.cn: 她在店里买了一条面包。

ex.en: I usually just have bread and butter for breakfast.
ex.cn: 我一般早餐就吃黄油面包。

defs.en: a sweet food that you make from flour, eggs, sugar and butter

ex.en: He ate a piece of chocolate cake.
ex.cn: 他吃了一块巧克力蛋糕。

ex.cn: 我们给她烤了个生日蛋糕。

an animal that has a thick shell around its body and lives in water

ex.en: the giant sea turtle.
ex.cn: …那只巨大的海龟。

defs.en: an animal that you keep in your home

ex.en: Do you have any pets?
ex.cn: 你养的有宠物吗？

defs.en: not large in size or amount
young

defs.cn: 不太严重的；不太重要的
defs.en: not very serious or important

ex.cn: 我女儿要比同龄人个头小。

ex.cn: 用少量黄油煎一下洋葱。

ex.en: I have two small children.
ex.cn: 我有两个小孩。

defs.en: the long thin part at the end of an animal's body
the end or the back of something

ex.en: The dog barked and wagged its tail.
ex.cn: 那只狗叫了声，摇了摇尾巴。

ex.en: The plane's tail hit the runway while it was landing.
ex.cn: 飞机降落时，尾部与跑道相撞。

defs.en: a lot of time
lasting for a lot of time
measuring a great distance from one end to the other
used for describing a great distance

ex.en: Cleaning up didn't take too long.
ex.cn: 清理工作没花多长时间。

ex.en: Have you been waiting long?
ex.cn: 你等了很久了吗?

ex.en: We had a long meeting.
ex.cn: 我们开了一个很长的会。

defs.en: to move your body to music
a particular series of movements that you usually do in time to music
a party where people dance with each other

ex.cn: 她打开收音机，在房间四处跳起舞来。

ex.en: a traditional Scottish dance
ex.cn: 苏格兰传统舞蹈

defs.en: an animal with feathers and wings

ex.cn: 我一靠近鸟就飞走了。

defs.en: an animal that is sometimes kept by people as a pet, or used to guard buildings

ex.cn: 她是这么个小淘气。

ex.cn: 布赖恩在科罗拉多河学会钓鱼。

ex.cn: …一只从蛋壳里孵出来的雏鸟。

ex.en: Brush the top with egg.

ex.cn: 这种虎产于印度。

ex.cn: 有斑点的是豹还是虎？

defs.en: a soft, flat hat with a curved part at the front
the lid of a bottle

ex.cn: 他头戴一顶深蓝色棒球帽。

ex.en: She took the cap off her water bottle and drank.
ex.cn: 她拧开水瓶的盖子喝了起来。

defs.en: things that you wear on your feet

ex.cn: 我需要一双新鞋。

ex.en: I don't usually wear high-heeled shoes.
ex.cn: 我通常不穿高跟鞋。

defs.en: a piece of clothing with long sleeves that you wear over other clothes when you go outside
an animal's fur or hair
a thin layer of paint
to cover something with a thin layer of a substance

ex.cn: 他穿上外套走了出去。

ex.cn: 前门需要刷一层新漆。

ex.cn: 用面粉将鱼裹上。

defs.en: a small animal covered with fur that people in some countries keep as a pet

ex.cn: 这只猫坐在我的大腿上，发出呼噜声。

defs.en: large in size
important or serious
older

ex.cn: 澳大利亚面积很大。

ex.en: Her husband was a big man.
ex.cn: 她丈夫是个大块头。

defs.en: not lasting very long
not tall

ex.cn: 去年我们都去布赖顿度了个短假。

ex.cn: 她个子不高，头发灰白。

ex.cn: 餐厅离这里不远。

defs.en: a piece of clothing that you wear on your hand, with a separate part for each finger

ex.cn: 他把手套放在口袋里。

ex.cn: 他身穿一件黑色皮夹克。

ex.cn: 栅栏把我的毛衣挂住了。

ex.cn: 我的毛衣缩水了。

defs.en: a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist downwards, and that covers each leg separately

ex.cn: 他穿着一件棕色的衬衫。

ex.cn: 牛仔裤非常适合日常穿着。

defs.cn: （用于疑问句中表示征求意见）可以，该

ex.cn: 你得坚决，认准的事就去做。

ex.en: This strong plastic will not crack.
ex.cn: 这种结实的塑料不会破裂。

defs.en: having a feeling of surprise when something happens, because you did not expect it to happen

ex.en: I was surprised at how easy it was.
ex.cn: 我吃惊于其容易。

defs.en: to move forward quickly, jumping from one foot to the other
to jump repeatedly over a rope

defs.cn: 跳过，略过，不做（常做的事）
defs.en: to decide not to do something that you usually do

ex.en: We skipped down the street, talking and laughing.
ex.cn: 我们沿着街蹦蹦跳跳地走，谈笑风生。

ex.en: She took the rope and began to skip.
ex.cn: 她拿起绳子开始跳起来。

defs.en: to be on your feet
to move so that you are on your feet
to be in a place
a small structure where you can buy things like food, drink and newspapers

ex.en: She was standing beside my bed.
ex.cn: 她站在我床边。

ex.en: The house stands alone on top of a hill.
ex.cn: 房子孤零零地坐落在一座小山顶上。

ex.en: I bought a magazine from a newspaper stand.
ex.cn: 我从报摊买了一本杂志。

defs.en: a game for two or four players, who use rackets (= special bats) to hit a ball across a net between them

ex.en: I'm not much good at tennis.
ex.cn: 我不太擅长打网球。

ex.en: He's not much of a tennis player.
ex.cn: 他算不上网球好手。

defs.en: the day after Saturday and before Monday

ex.en: We went for a walk on Sunday.
ex.cn: 我们周日出门散了个步。

defs.en: a piece of electrical equipment with a screen on which you watch moving pictures with sound
the moving pictures and sounds that you watch and listen to on a television

ex.en: She turned the television on.
ex.cn: 她打开电视。

ex.en: Michael spends too much time watching television.
ex.cn: 迈克尔花太多时间看电视了。

ex.en: What's on television tonight?
ex.cn: 今晚有什么电视节目？

defs.en: used when you want to show that you are grateful for something
things that you say when you are grateful to someone for something

ex.en: Thanks for the information.
ex.cn: 谢谢提供这个信息。

ex.en: `Tea?' — `No thanks.'
ex.cn: “喝茶吗？”——“不了，谢谢。”

ex.en: I would like to express my thanks to the wonderful hospital staff.
ex.cn: 我想对了不起的医护人员表示感谢。

defs.en: the number 10

ex.en: Over the past ten years things have changed.
ex.cn: 在过去的10年中，情况已经发生了变化。

defs.en: to say `thank you' to someone to show that you are grateful to them for something

ex.en: I thanked them for all their kindness to me.
ex.cn: 我对他们的一番好意表示感谢。

defs.en: the number 13

ex.en: "Thirteen?" he guessed wildly.
ex.cn: “十三？”他胡乱猜道。

ex.en: He ran away from home at the age of thirteen.
ex.cn: 他十三岁时离家出走。

defs.cn: 这些（指离自己近的人或物）
defs.en: used for talking about people or things that are near you, especially when you touch them or point to them

defs.cn: 这些（指已经提及的人或物）
defs.en: used for talking about someone or something that you have already mentioned

defs.cn: 这些（引出将要提及的人或事）
defs.en: used for introducing people or things that you are going to talk about

ex.en: These scissors are heavy.
ex.cn: 这些剪刀很沉。

ex.en: These people need more support.
ex.cn: 这些人需要更多的支持。

ex.en: If you're looking for a builder, these phone numbers will be useful.
ex.cn: 如果你在找建筑工人，这些电话号码可能会有用。

defs.en: a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or sit at
a set of facts or numbers that you arrange in neat rows

ex.en: Mum was sitting at the kitchen table.
ex.cn: 妈妈坐在餐桌旁。

ex.en: See the table on page 104.
ex.cn: 参阅第104页的表格。

defs.en: used for talking about a person or a thing that is near you, especially when you touch them or point to them

defs.cn: 这，这个（指代先前提及的人或物）
defs.en: used for talking about someone or something that you have already mentioned

defs.cn: 本，今，这个（指接下来的某天、月或季）
defs.en: used for talking about the next day, month or season

defs.cn: 这位，这个（尤指所触碰或指向的离自己较近的人或物）
defs.en: used for talking about a person or a thing that is near you, especially when you touch them or point to them

ex.en: How can we solve this problem?
ex.cn: 我们如何能解决这个问题呢？

ex.en: We have tickets for this Sunday's performance.
ex.cn: 我们有这周六表演的门票。

ex.en: We're getting married this June.
ex.cn: 我们将在今年六月结婚。

defs.en: the number 30

ex.en: Mozart clearly enjoyed good health throughout his twenties and early thirties.
ex.cn: 莫扎特显然在二十几岁和三十刚出头时身体很好。

ex.en: She became quite a notable director in the thirties and forties.
ex.cn: 她在20世纪的三四十年代成为一位名导演。

defs.cn: 教师，老师，教员；<喻>给人教益的事物

ex.en: I'm a teacher with 21 years' experience.
ex.cn: 我是一个有21年经验的教师。

defs.en: wanting to drink something

ex.en: Drink some water whenever you feel thirsty.
ex.cn: 无论何时感到口渴就喝些水。

defs.en: a tall plant that lives for a long time. It has a hard central part (= a trunk), branches and leaves
higher than other people or things
used when you are asking or talking about the height of someone or something

ex.en: John is very tall.
ex.cn: 约翰个子很高。

ex.en: The lighthouse is a tall square tower.
ex.cn: 灯塔是一座高高的方形塔。

ex.en: `How tall are you?' — `I'm six foot five.'
ex.cn: “你有多高？”——“我身高六英尺五英寸。”

defs.en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday

ex.en: He phoned on Tuesday, just before you arrived.
ex.cn: 他星期二来电话了，就在你来之前。

ex.en: Work on the project will start next Tuesday.
ex.cn: 这个项目的工作下星期二启动。

defs.en: the number 12

ex.en: He retired twelve batters in a row.
ex.cn: 他一连使十二个击球手出局。

ex.en: It's ten past twelve.
ex.cn: 现在十二点十分。

defs.cn: 美国，美利坚合众国（the United States of America）；（军事）美国陆军（United States Army）
宇佐（日本地名、人名 Usa 的罗马字）；尤萨（人名 Usa 的译名）

ex.en: Do you need a visa for the USA?
ex.cn: 你需要美国签证吗？

ex.en: I bought a copy of "USA Today" from a street-corner machine.
ex.cn: 我从售货机上买了一份《今日美国》。

defs.en: the number 2

ex.en: Putting two and two together, I assume that this was the car he used.
ex.cn: 根据所掌握的信息判断，我认为这就是他用的那辆车。

defs.en: a single, complete thing that can belong to something larger
a measurement

ex.en: The building is divided into twelve units.
ex.cn: 大楼被划分成十二个单元。

ex.en: A centimetre is a unit of measurement.
ex.cn: 厘米是一种计量单位。

defs.en: the number 20

ex.en: They're both in their twenties and both married with children of their own.
ex.cn: 他们俩都二十几岁了，都已结婚有了自己的孩子。

ex.en: It was written in the Twenties, but it still really stands out.
ex.cn: 它写于20世纪20年代，但现在仍很引人注目。

defs.en: used when you are talking about the actual day on which you are speaking or writing
used when you are talking about the present period of history

ex.en: How are you feeling today?
ex.cn: 你今天感觉怎么样？

ex.en: More people have cars today.
ex.cn: 如今越来越多的人们有车。

ex.en: I like music, and I like this walkman, too.
ex.cn: 我喜欢音乐，我也喜欢这个随身听。

ex.en: We are cabling you our new price for our walkman.
ex.cn: 我们正通过电传向贵方发送我方随身听的新报价。

defs.en: a plant that you can cook and eat

ex.en: A good general diet should include plenty of fresh vegetables.
ex.cn: 一份良好的日常饮食应当包括大量的新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: compounds of animal, vegetable or mineral origin.
ex.cn: …来自动物、植物或矿物的化合物。

defs.en: a very small town in the countryside

ex.en: He lives quietly in the country in a village near Lahti.
ex.cn: 他在乡下拉赫蒂附近的一个村庄里过着平静的生活。

defs.en: something that we measure in minutes, hours, days and years
used when you are talking about a particular point in the day, that you describe in hours and minutes
the point in the day when something happens
used for talking about a particular period of time in the past

ex.en: Time passed, and still Mary did not come back.
ex.cn: 时间一点点流逝，玛丽仍然没有回来。

ex.en: I've known Mr Martin for a long time.
ex.cn: 我认识马丁先生很久了。

ex.en: Listen to me. I haven't got much time.
ex.cn: 听我说，我没有太多时间。

defs.en: a large, heavy fruit with green skin, pink flesh and black seeds

ex.en: Watermelon contains vitamins and also potassium.
ex.cn: 西瓜含有维生素也有钾。

ex.en: They planted some watermelon.
ex.cn: 他们种了些西瓜。

defs.en: having some heat, but not hot
made of a material that protects you from the cold
friendly

ex.en: On warm summer days, she would sit outside.
ex.cn: 在温暖的夏天，她会坐在外面。

ex.en: Because it was warm, David wore only a white cotton shirt.
ex.cn: 因为天气暖和，戴维只穿了一件白色的棉衬衫。

ex.en: You need to wear warm clothes when you go out today.
ex.cn: 你今天出去的时候需要穿暖和的衣服。

defs.en: to look at someone or something for a period of time
to take care of someone or something for a period of time
a small clock that you wear on your wrist

ex.en: A man stood in the doorway, watching me.
ex.cn: 一个男人站在门口，注视着我。

ex.en: I stayed up late to watch the film.
ex.cn: 我熬夜看电影了。

ex.en: Could you watch my bags? I need to go to the bathroom.
ex.cn: 你能帮我看一下包吗？我要去洗手间。

defs.en: a clear, thin liquid that has no colour or taste. It falls from clouds as rain
to pour water over plants in order to help them to grow
when your eyes water, tears appear in them

ex.en: Could I have a glass of water, please?
ex.cn: 请给我一杯水好吗?

ex.en: Make sure you water the plants before you go on holiday.
ex.cn: 你去度假前一定要给植物浇水。

ex.en: His eyes were watering in the smoke.
ex.cn: 他的眼睛在烟中流泪。

defs.en: one of the sides of a building or a room
a long narrow structure made of stone or brick that divides an area of land

ex.en: His bedroom walls are covered with pictures of cars.
ex.cn: 他卧室的墙上挂满了汽车的照片。

ex.en: He sat on the wall in the sun.
ex.cn: 他坐在城墙上晒太阳。

defs.en: the temperature and conditions outside, for example if it is raining, hot or windy

ex.en: The weather was bad.
ex.cn: 天气很糟糕。

ex.en: I like cold weather.
ex.cn: 我喜欢寒冷的天气。

ex.en: Have you heard the weather forecast this morning?
ex.cn: 你今天早上听天气预报了吗?

defs.en: having a small distance between one side and the other
having no extra fat on your body
flowing easily

ex.en: The book is printed on very thin paper.
ex.cn: 这书就印在很薄的纸张上。

ex.en: Bob was a tall, thin man.
ex.cn: 鲍勃是个又高又瘦的男人。

ex.en: His arms and legs were very thin.
ex.cn: 他的胳膊和腿都很瘦。

defs.en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday

ex.en: Come and have supper with us on Wednesday.
ex.cn: 星期三来和我们一起吃晚饭吧。

defs.en: having the colour of snow or milk
White people have a pale skin.
white wine is a pale-yellow colour
white coffee or tea has milk in it

ex.en: He had nice white teeth.
ex.cn: 他长着漂亮的白牙齿。

ex.en: He was dressed in white from head to toe.
ex.cn: 他从头到脚穿着白色衣服。

defs.en: the activity of swimming, especially as a sport or for pleasure

ex.en: Swimming is a great form of exercise.
ex.cn: 游泳是一种很好的锻炼方式。

defs.en: the season between autumn and spring. In the winter the weather is usually cold

ex.en: In winter the nights are long and cold.
ex.cn: 冬天的夜晚又长又冷。

defs.en: to act in a friendly way when someone arrives somewhere
used for being friendly to someone who has just arrived somewhere

ex.en: She was there to welcome him home.
ex.cn: 她在那儿欢迎他回家。

defs.en: an adult female human being

ex.en: She was a tall, dark woman, with an unusual face.
ex.cn: 她是个身材高大、皮肤黝黑的女人，长着一张不同寻常的脸。

defs.en: a park where animals are kept and people can go to look at them

ex.en: He took his son to the zoo.
ex.cn: 他带着儿子去了动物园。

defs.en: a period of twelve months, beginning on the first of January and ending on the thirty-first of December
any period of twelve months
the period of time in the year when schools or universities are open
used for talking about a long time

ex.en: The year was 1840.
ex.cn: 这一年是1840年。

ex.en: We had an election last year.
ex.cn: 去年我们有一次选举。

ex.en: The castle has more than 650,000 visitors a year.
ex.cn: 这座城堡一年的游客量超过65万人次。

defs.en: with a lot of wind

ex.en: It was a wet and windy day.
ex.cn: 这是一个多雨多风的日子。

defs.en: a unit of language with meaning

ex.en: The Italian word for `love' is `amore'.
ex.cn: 意大利语中的love是amore这个词。

defs.en: a wild horse with black and white stripes that lives in Africa

ex.en: The lion was stalking a zebra.
ex.cn: 狮子偷偷接近斑马。

ex.en: The quagga was a strikingly beautiful variant of the zebra.
ex.cn: 白氏斑马是一种极其美丽的斑马变种。

defs.en: used for talking about the day before today
of the colour of lemons or butter

ex.en: She was wearing a yellow dress.
ex.cn: 她穿着一条黄裙子。

defs.en: used for giving a positive answer to a question

defs.cn: （用于接受提议、请求或表示许可）可以，好的
defs.en: used for accepting an offer or a request, or for giving permission

ex.en: `Are you a friend of Nick's?' — `Yes.'
ex.cn: “你是尼克的朋友吗？”——“是的。”

ex.en: `More coffee?' — `Yes please.'
ex.cn: “再来点咖啡？”——“好的，麻烦了。”

ex.en: `Could you help me, please?' — `Yes, of course.'
ex.cn: “请问您能帮帮我吗？”——“好的，当然。”

defs.en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday

ex.en: On Thursday Barbara invited me to her house for lunch.
ex.cn: 芭芭拉邀请我周四去她家吃午饭。

ex.en: We go to the supermarket every Thursday morning.
ex.cn: 我们每周四上午都去超市。
